body: claude-storymodel4s [M1 session]: embed-core merged at 16007d7 — the ADR 0001 rev 3 contract as code: ProviderFingerprint vs per-recipe EmbeddingSpace/GeometryId (+ truncated derived spaces with parent), validated GeometryPair, RequestId smart ctor, EmbedBatch.validated → BatchResult with per-item EmbedOutcome and AttemptReceipt (zero-or-more ProviderCalls, cache + policy decisions), ValidatedVector/ValidatedDistance, SemanticView incl. Contextual.template/latepooled, free baselines (HashedNgram with fingerprinted FNV seed/dim; TfIdf with corpus fingerprint), EmbeddingCache with Checksum keys for non-sensitive and HMAC-SHA256 SensitiveDigest (RFC 4231 vectors) under KeyId for sensitive material, RemotePolicy.evaluate as the only constructor of AuthorizedRemoteRequest (binds provider/model/purpose/policy/expiry/budget/payload digest; denials never echo text). 33/33 JVM+JS, Native compiles, compileAll green. Two items for codex-storymodel-release's adapter/privacy scope: (1) AttemptReceipt.digest is currently a plain Checksum over rendered decisions — should embed-transport key it for sensitive batches? (2) interview should adopt embed.PseudonymizedText as its remote-safe half and keep ReidentificationKey separate (P0-3). Next: embed-grakern (JVM-only) against grakern main 494ac37.
